commits.author: Franz Hemmer
commits.message:
Enhance Tavily web search with AI answers and raw content

- Add SearchDepth, IncludeAnswer, and IncludeRawContent options to WebSearchOptions
- Add RawContent property to WebSearchResult model
- Update TavilySearchService to use configurable search options
- Prepend AI-generated answer as first result when Tavily returns one
- Update system prompt to prioritize web search for weather queries
- Update tool description to explicitly mention weather support
- Add test coverage for AI answer prepending and raw content
- Update NuGet packages: Microsoft.Extensions.* to 10.0.2, Microsoft.Extensions.AI to 10.2.0
- Update Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers to 10.0.102
- Add PostTestMessage.ps1 and Test-ReliasAssistantSlack.ps1 test utilities
- Fix run.ps1 to set ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development
- Fix Directory.Build.targets to prefer system dotnet.exe
